Subject: Re: Restricting internal distribution list: warning: unknown smtpd restriction: "insiders_only"

Wietse Venema escreveu:
> If that is not the problem, then you need to post logging of an
> incident with the actual configuration settings.
>   
Shame....
For the internet records, I'll bang my head against the wall till 
saturday. On an earlier mail I said:

  

>> I even tried this on master.cf:
>>
>> 127.0.0.1:10025 inet    n -  n  -   -   smtpd
>> -o content_filter=
>> -o local_recipient_maps=
>> -o relay_recipient_maps=
>> -o smtpd_restriction_classes=
>> -o smtpd_client_restrictions=
>> -o smtpd_helo_restrictions=
>> -o smtpd_sender_restrictions=
>> -o smtpd_restriction_classes=
>> -o mynetworks=127.0.0.0/8
>>     

Notice the double entry for smtpd_restriction_classes. The last one I've 
input in a blind desperate try to fix the problem, and didn't notice 
_that was already there_ (this server is not my child), and _that was 
the problem_. I just removed both smtpd_restriction_classes from 
master.cf and it now works.

Really sorry to make you all waste precious time, hope this mail saves 
someone else's. Perhaps this could go into documentation FAQ to check 
that on master.cf.

Best regards.

-- 
Marcio Merlone
